sec: Salmonellosis: weekly clinical course, salient features, investigations and media

items.q: Salmonellosis by week — match — 1) Week 1 2) Week 3 … A) Ileocaecal hyperplasia with GI perforation and bleeding, encephalopathy B) Step-ladder fever with or without chills, relative bradycardia, vague abdominal pain and GI upset
items.exp: Week 1: '· Step ladder fever ± chills, · Relative bradycardia, Vague abdominal pain, GI disturbances'. Week 3: 'Ileocoecal hyperplasia > GI perforation, bleeding' and 'Encephalopathy'. (Book p1054)

items.q: Which pulse-temperature relationship is printed for the first week of salmonellosis?
items.exp: '· Relative bradycardia' is listed under week 1. (Book p1054)

items.q: Judge the week-3 column: I Ileocaecal hyperplasia can progress to GI perforation and bleeding. II Encephalopathy is listed as a week-3 complication.
items.exp: Week 3 prints 'Ileocoecal hyperplasia > GI perforation, bleeding' and 'Encephalopathy'. (Book p1054)

items.q: Which complication is printed for the chronic carrier state of Salmonella?
items.exp: 'Complication : Gall stones in chronic carrier state'. (Book p1054)

items.q: Investigations — match the test to its printed yield — 1) Widal 2) Blood culture … A) 90% positivity in the first week B) Low positivity in the first and second weeks, 80-100% positivity by the third week
items.exp: Widal: '· Low positivity (1st and 2nd week), 80-100% positivity (3rd week)'. Blood culture: '· 90% positivity (1st week)'. (Book p1054)

items.q: What positivity does the page print for Widal in the third week?
Which culture medium is printed as giving jet-black colonies for Salmonella?
items.exp: 'Wilson Blair bismuth sulphite agar : Jet black colonies'. (Book p1054)

items.q: Which medium is NOT printed in the salmonellosis investigations?
items.exp: Printed: blood culture (90% first week), MacConkey agar and Wilson-Blair bismuth sulphite agar. (Book p1054)

items.q: Rose spots are illustrated on this page next to which disease section?
items.exp: The 'Rose spots' label sits in the salmonellosis page image. (Book p1054)

items.q: A patient in the third week of enteric fever has abdominal guarding and a drop in blood pressure. Which week-3 complication does the page list?
opts: GI perforation and bleeding from ileocaecal hyperplasia
items.exp: Week 3: 'Ileocoecal hyperplasia > GI perforation, bleeding'. (Book p1054)
